description_en: Leipzig is the most populous trade city in the Saxony State. Leipzig has been a trade city since at least the time of the Holy Roman Empire Holy Roman Empire Via Regia and the Via Imperii, two important medieval trade routes, intersected here

description_en: Hamburg, a major port city in northern Germany, is connected to the North Sea by the Elbe River. It's crossed by hundreds of canals, and also contains large areas of park

title: Lubeka - Niemcy
description: Lubeka to północnoniemieckie miasto gotycką architekturą, sięgającą czasów średniowiecznej stolicy Ligi Hanzy, konfederacji handlowej. Jej symbolem jest Holstentor, brama miejska

description_en: Lübeck is a northern German city with Gothic architecture, dating back to the medieval capital of the Hanseatic League, a powerful trade confederation. Its symbol is the Holstenor, the city gate

title: Zamek w Schwerin - Niemcy
description: Zamek w Schwerinie przyciąga uwagę. Bogactwo detali sprawia, że kolos wydaje się zarówno pełen wdzięku, jak i bajkowej lekkości.

description_en: Schwerin Castle is an eye-catcher. The fabulous wealth of details makes the colossus seem both graceful and light.

title: Wismar - Niemcy
description: Wismar to miasto znane z dobrze zachowanej średniowiecznej zabudowy. Nie ucierpiało podczas wojen i można podziwiać architekturę w prawie niezmienionej formie.

description_en: Wismar is a city known for its well-preserved medieval architecture. It escaped war damage, allowing visitors to admire its buildings in a virtually unaltered state.

description_en: Rogalin is a town located in the west of Polish on the Warta River. It is known for its Baroque palace complex, gallery and neoclassical church with the mausoleum of the Raczyński family.
